headline: Turull Calls to Rein In Vulture Funds, but Without Criminalizing Small Property Owners
summary: Junts general secretary Jordi Turull said his party supports reining in vulture funds. He asked the Spanish government not to mix the housing decree with measures that he says criminalize small property owners.
why: Vulture funds buy distressed loans and properties, and rules on them affect the housing market, real estate investors and Spain's broader property and credit landscape.
